payload.title: Chatticus: what a Story agent needs
payload.description: Gaps found 2026-11-02. A channel belongs to one user but a Story conversation is shared by editors. No general sub-agent tool found in the Chatticus tree (the task tool is household tasks). Bots provision a computer, heavy for one bot per Story; check the computerless profile. Papyrus pins an unmerged Chatticus commit, 10 ahead and 13 behind main.
